V. 3.
Then Mary taking a pound of ointment—There •ere two Perſons, who poured Ointment on Chriſt. One, toward the Beginning of his Miniſtry, at or near Naia: (Luke vii. 37, &c.) The other, ſix Days before his laſt Paſſover, at Bethany; the Account of whom is given here, as well as by St. Matthew and Mark.
